title: MERN Stack Intern
description:
**Company Description** 




 Brainy Neurals is a leading Artificial Intelligence development company based in Ahmedabad, India, transforming how businesses operate since 2023\. The company builds end\-to\-end AI solutions, including computer vision for quality and safety, custom chatbots for customer interactions, and edge AI models that run in real time on devices without relying on the cloud. With deep expertise in NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Intel technologies, and modern AI frameworks, Brainy Neurals delivers tailored solutions that drive measurable business growth. The team works across domains such as custom AI product development, vision analytics, data analytics, robotics, and business automation using AI. Brainy Neurals is committed to ongoing research and development, ensuring clients benefit from the most advanced and efficient AI capabilities available.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a remote, contract MERN Stack Intern role focused on supporting AI\-driven web application development. Day\-to\-day tasks include assisting in building and maintaining web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js, implementing RESTful APIs, and integrating front\-end interfaces with back\-end services. The intern will collaborate with senior developers and AI engineers to connect web applications with AI models, participate in code reviews, and help troubleshoot and fix bugs. Responsibilities also include writing clean, documented code, contributing to basic UI/UX improvements, and following best practices for performance, security, and scalability. The intern will be expected to learn quickly, take feedback constructively, and communicate progress regularly with the distributed team.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess core MERN skills, including basic experience with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.
* Candidates should possess front\-end development skills such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and familiarity with responsive design and component\-based architecture.
* Candidates should possess back\-end and API skills, including RESTful API development, JSON handling, and integration with databases.
* Candidates should possess software development fundamentals such as version control (Git), debugging, testing basics, and understanding of secure coding practices.
* Candidates should possess problem\-solving and collaboration skills, including the ability to read documentation, learn new tools quickly, and work effectively in a remote, cross\-functional team.
* Relevant academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) is beneficial.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, cloud or edge deployment, or interest in building AI\-enabled applications is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to manage time and tasks in a remote setup are expected.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems \& Orchestration
 



**Experience Level:** 
 Senior (5\+ years of software engineering experience)
 



**Work Mode** 
 : Hybrid/Remote
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a AI Engineer to design, build, and maintain production\-grade
 **agentic systems** 
 and robust AI harnesses. In this role, you will bridge traditional software engineering (Python, .NET, modern frontend) with advanced Generative AI pattern design. You will build deterministic control loops around non\-deterministic LLM behaviors, implement end\-to\-end workflow orchestration, establish full observability, and create automated evaluation pipelines to ensure high\-reliability AI deployment at scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Agentic Architecture \& Harness Engineering:** 
 Architect robust agent execution harnesses that manage context, enforce safety boundary limits, implement tool calling, and manage dynamic execution loops (ReAct, reflection, plan\-and\-execute).
* **Workflow Orchestration \& Loops:** 
 Implement complex multi\-step workflows using stateful orchestration engines. Design resilient human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) checkpoints, automated retry logic, backoff mechanisms, and self\-correcting execution loops.
* **Full\-Stack Implementation:** 
 Develop core microservices and APIs in
 **Python** 
 and
 **.NET (C\#)** 
 while building responsive, real\-time user interfaces (React/TypeScript, Vue, or Angular) for stream tracking and human intervention.
* **Observability \& Tracing:** 
 Instrument full\-stack telemetry across agent execution graphs. Track trace IDs, latency bottlenecks, token consumption patterns, tool invocation success, and intermediate decision steps across complex agent runs.
* **Evaluation \& Testing Frameworks (Evals):** 
 Build automated evaluation pipelines using LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, unit evals, regression test suites, and dynamic benchmarks to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and task completion metrics before release.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**1\. Software Engineering Core** 



* **5\+ years** 
 of professional software engineering experience delivering production software.
* **Backend:** 
 Advanced proficiency in
 **Python** 
 (FastAPI, Django, Pydantic) and
 **.NET / C\#** 
 (ASP.NET Core, Task Parallel Library, dependency injection patterns).
* **Frontend:** 
 Strong experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) to construct interactive, real\-time monitoring dashboards or agent human\-in\-the\-loop interfaces.
* **Architecture:** 
 Firm understanding of asynchronous processing, queue systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus), distributed state management, and REST/WebSocket APIs.



  





**2\. Agentic Systems \& AI Concepts** 



* **Agentic Patterns:** 
 Hands\-on experience building autonomous or semi\-autonomous agentic workflows, function calling pipelines, long/short\-term memory structures, and iterative loop controls.
* **Workflow Orchestration:** 
 Experience using frameworks designed for graph/state control and workflow management, such as
 **LangGraph** 
 ,
 **Temporal** 
 ,
 **Semantic Kernel Process Framework** 
 ,
 **AutoGen** 
 , or
 **LlamaIndex Workflows** 
 .
* **Observability \& Monitoring:** 
 Hands\-on integration experience with telemetry and tracing platforms like
 **LangSmith** 
 ,
 **Phoenix (Arize)** 
 ,
 **Langfuse** 
 , or
 **OpenTelemetry** 
 .
* **Evaluation \& Testing:** 
 Proven track record setting up continuous evaluation (Evals) using tools such as
 **Ragas** 
 ,
 **DeepEval** 
 ,
 **Promptfoo** 
 , or custom LLM\-as\-a\-Judge test runners integrated into CI/CD pipelines.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Deep experience deploying on cloud platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI).
* Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, PGVector) and hybrid search mechanisms.
* Experience with guardrail systems (Guardrails AI, NeMo Guardrails) to constrain agent behavior and enforce runtime safety.
* Background in deterministic fallbacks for non\-deterministic model outputs.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary and performance\-based equity/bonus.
* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.
* Flexible work setup (Remote / Hybrid).
* Annual learning allowance for research, AI tools, and technical conferences.



  





**Note (BGV):** 
 \*\*As part of the candidate onboarding, we would conduct a candidate background check that includes education, employment history, criminal records, Reference check, etc.\*\*
 



  





**Company Information:** 
 Reveation Labs is a USA\-based, AI\-enabled digital solutions partner helping mid\-market B2B organizations accelerate digital transformation and business growth. With deep expertise in B2B eCommerce, Customer Portals, Product Data \& Integration Management, AI Enabled Digital Transformation, Cloud Computing, and Enterprise Systems Integration, Reveation Labs delivers scalable, outcome\-driven solutions that streamline operations and enhance customer experiences. Backed by industry experts with extensive experience in enterprise technology and digital innovation, the company combines strategic consulting, modern engineering practices, and emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation to help organizations achieve measurable business results and long\-term success.
 



  





**Why Reveation Labs?** 
 We Truly Believe that where your work matters \& as a software company, we know a thing or two about what makes employees happy. When you Join Reveation Labs, you do more than simply switch companies to advance your career. You become part of the Reveation Labs Family, a group of talented people who drive innovation, embrace change \& celebrate the global community which is Reveation Labs.

title: ML Technical Lead
description:
**Job Purpose:** 




  





 Lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions that drive business impact. Architect production\-ready AI systems, mentor engineering teams, and collaborate across functions to deliver intelligent, enterprise\-grade products.
 



  





**Who You Are:** 



* 8\+ years of overall software development experience, including 4\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying Machine Learning/AI solutions in production.
* 2 years of experience leading technical teams, driving architecture, mentoring engineers, and delivering complex AI projects.
* Experience working in software services, consulting, or product engineering environments with exposure to multiple client engagements.
* possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable AI solutions.
* passionate about emerging AI technologies and continuously strive to improve engineering practices and product quality.



  





**What Will Excite Us:** 



* Strong expertise in Python, Object\-Oriented Programming, SQL, and REST API development using FastAPI or Flask.
* Hands\-on experience with Machine Learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit\-learn, or XGBoost.
* Experience building and managing production ML pipelines using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or dbt.
* Practical experience with Generative AI technologies, including LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, and Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, or Milvus.
* Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native application deployment.
* Strong understanding of model deployment, monitoring, scalability, and MLOps best practices.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and client teams.



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions.
* Build, deploy, and maintain production\-grade ML models and AI applications with high availability and scalability.
* Design end\-to\-end ML pipelines covering data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Develop APIs and backend services to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Engineers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor engineering teams through code reviews, technical guidance, and best engineering practices.
* Drive architectural decisions, technology selection, and technical excellence across AI initiatives.
* Ensure AI systems are secure, reliable, observable, and optimized for production workloads.
* Stay current with advancements in Machine Learning, MLOps, Large Language Models, and Generative AI to continuously improve solutions and engineering standards.



  





**Location: Ahmedabad (WFO)**
